title: Proof bundle verification result
description: The result of 'vlab verify-proof <file>'. Integrity checks the payload hash; classification checks stated verdicts, counts, and commit uniqueness; repository comparison checks evidence, complete ordered source history, identities, subjects, lineage, counts, and physical/effective bases (FR-PLAN-08). Offline success does not establish source completeness.

integrity.description: Whether the bundle's own hash still matches its contents. Intact means unedited since production, not trustworthy: whoever produced it could restate the hash.

classification.description: Re-derive every supplied change from the stated evidence, check counts against the supplied statuses, and reject duplicate commit entries. This checks internal consistency, not source completeness.

uniqueCommits.description: Whether each supplied commit appears at most once.

repository.description: Comparison against repository facts, including the complete ordered source inventory and physical/effective bases. Unrelated repositories and moved or missing heads are reported as skipped. Read failures after repository discovery are errors.

reason.description: Why the comparison was skipped: not-requested, not-a-repository, bundle-incomplete, different-repository, target-moved, source-moved, or source-ref-missing. different-repository is checked first and is the only reason meaning the bundle will never apply here; the rest mean this repository has moved since the bundle was built.

checks.description: Comparisons performed when checked is true. matches is true only when every comparison succeeds.

ok.description: True when the hash matches, classifications and counts agree, commit entries are unique, and the repository comparison did not contradict the bundle. A skipped comparison narrows what is proven: source completeness, identities, and bases remain unchecked.
